source_review_findings: Expected SHA and length are derived from actual successful writer calls, independently of later filesystem hashing.
Original and separate-inode content-addressed copy are validated before publishing a fsynced commit binding; cooperating duplicate writers and commits are excluded.
Dependent reads require an externally pinned commit and valid reservation/stream-close/original/copy identities. A surviving duplicate does not silently replace a missing original.
Partial or over-cap captures cannot commit; declared injected failures and surviving data remain in the qualification artifacts.
